name: my-post-factory
description: Save time on editorial content tasks by preparing drafts, reviewing posts and scheduling social publications from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
My Post Factory helps you save time and improve productivity when managing editorial content for social media from ChatGPT. Prepare draft content, review and edit posts, organize reusable media and schedule publications in one workflow. Reuse existing media and automate recurring publishing tasks to reduce repetitive work and manual steps. Create drafts, edit posts and schedule them to connected social profiles and pages. Check recent posts, recurring automations and your publication calendar to keep track of your editorial work.

A connected My Post Factory account is required. The plugin accesses only the resources allowed by your account authorization. Text and media generation use configured AI providers, with optional public-web research. Active automations may publish without another review when configured to do so. The account history limit may remove older eligible posts and private generated media. Engagement statistics and social comments are not supported.
defaultPrompt: List up to 5 of my recent one-shot posts.

positive.prompt: In My Post Factory, what is my current credit balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the balance from credits.balance, or explain unlimited access when credits.unlimited is true. Do not invent a balance.

positive.prompt: In My Post Factory, list my automations.
positive.expected_behavior: List the automations returned by the tool. If automations is empty, say there are no automations.

positive.prompt: In My Post Factory, list my connected social destinations.
positive.expected_behavior: List the destinations returned by the tool. If destinations is empty, say no social destinations are connected.

positive.prompt: In My Post Factory, list up to 5 of my recent one-shot posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_one_shot_posts with limit=5 and list the returned posts. If posts is empty, say there are no one-shot posts.

positive.prompt: In My Post Factory, list my media library folders.
positive.expected_behavior: List the folders returned by the tool. If folders is empty, say there are no media library folders.

negative.prompt: Rewrite this sentence in a warmer tone: Registration is open. Keep it in this chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Rewrite the sentence in the conversation without calling My Post Factory tools.

negative.prompt: Use My Post Factory to show the number of likes on my last LinkedIn post.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that My Post Factory tools do not retrieve engagement statistics. Do not call its tools to retrieve likes.

negative.prompt: Use My Post Factory to change my payment card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that payment-card changes are handled in the application billing area, not by these tools. Do not call My Post Factory tools or request card details.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages social media content and publishing. Its tools do not sell products, create orders, collect payment details or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Emphasized time savings and editorial content productivity in the English and French descriptions. Retained the Productivity category, review tests and video URL. Application behavior is unchanged.

fr-FR.subtitle: Créez et planifiez vos posts
fr-FR.description:
My Post Factory vous aide à gagner du temps et en productivité dans la gestion de vos contenus éditoriaux pour les réseaux sociaux depuis ChatGPT. Préparez vos brouillons, relisez et modifiez vos posts, organisez vos médias réutilisables et planifiez vos publications dans un même processus. Réutilisez vos médias et automatisez les tâches de publication récurrentes pour réduire le travail répétitif et les étapes manuelles. Créez des brouillons, modifiez vos posts et planifiez leur publication sur les profils et pages connectés. Consultez vos posts récents, vos automatisations et votre calendrier de publication pour suivre votre travail éditorial.

Un compte My Post Factory connecté est nécessaire. Le plugin accède uniquement aux ressources autorisées lors de la connexion. La génération de textes et de médias utilise les fournisseurs IA configurés, avec une recherche web facultative. Les automatisations actives peuvent publier sans nouvelle relecture si elles sont configurées ainsi. La limite d’historique du compte peut supprimer les anciens posts éligibles et leurs médias générés privés. Les statistiques d’engagement et les commentaires des réseaux sociaux ne sont pas pris en charge.
